summary: Large rebuild verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering /api/track, /api/enquiries, auth (login/wrong/me), admin protection (401), analytics structure, and full review lifecycle (submit valid & short reject, public list scrubs email/phone/ip and only shows approved, admin list requires auth, approve/patch flow, invalid status, delete). Frontend: Home hero 'Speak. Shine. Succeed.' with tag pills, ascent SVG, WHO WE ARE, PROGRAMMES 4-card, WHY VOKTAA + stats, WHO WE SERVE 4 cards, CTA banner all present. Navbar has 6 links (Home, About Us, Programs, For Institutions, Reviews, Contact Us) + BOOK A DEMO CTA; no 'Blog' anywhere. Footer shows Guntur address, © 2026 VOKTAA Solutions, and signoff 'Speak. Shine. Succeed.' (rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform, source text has periods). No 'Vijayawada' leftover in footer/contact. /programs renders exactly 11 program cards (verified titles). /institutions loads with full content. /contact shows Guntur address, no Vijayawada. /about shows Raja Sekhar founder message and all 6 core values (Excellence, Integrity, Innovation, Professionalism, Collaboration, Continuous Learning). /reviews: form has all required data-testid fields, submits successfully and shows success screen with required copy; empty submit is blocked with validation toast. /admin/reviews redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated; after login it shows tabs pending/approved/rejected/all with counts and Approve/Reject/Delete buttons — approving a pending review moves it to Approved tab. Admin dashboard shows metric cards, Visits chart, Program Interest pie, CSV export, and 'REVIEWS →' link (data-testid=admin-reviews-link) to /admin/reviews. WhatsApp float uses wa.me/917416113199.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviews form role/programme use radix Select without an aria-label — screen readers announce only 'combobox'. Consider adding aria-label to review-role and review-program triggers.
server.py public GET /api/reviews strips email/phone/ip but still returns 'ip' via admin GET (expected) — fine, but consider indexing db.reviews on {status, timestamp} for scale.

seed_admin uses hardcoded ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD env defaults ('admin@example.com'/'admin123') — safe only because .env overrides them; recommend refusing to seed if envs are missing rather than defaulting.
seed_data_creation: During tests, several TEST_ prefixed reviews/enquiries were created; UI-approve flow left one review in DB after script errored on a public-list urllib call (returned 403 from python UA, unrelated). Safe to leave — flagged with TEST_ prefix. Cleanup can be done via admin UI or backend delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 17 tests covering auth, tracking, enquiries, analytics, and full reviews lifecycle. Reviews form uses shadcn Select (radix) for role and program — click the trigger, wait 300ms, then click role='option'. Admin login POSTs to /api/auth/login and stores Bearer token in localStorage key 'voktaa_token'. Footer signoff renders uppercase via CSS text-transform, so innerText comparisons against 'Speak. Shine. Succeed.' will fail — compare against source or the uppercased variant.
